scripts.predev: npm run build -w @rally/shared-types && npm run build -w @rally/shared-logic
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rally/shared-types && npm run build -w @rally/shared-logic && npm run build -w @rally/api && npm run build -w @rally/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rally/shared-logic && npm run test -w @rally/api && npm run test -w @rally/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rally/api && npm run lint -w @rally/web
